notes: The mechanical half of this eval is well covered by check_run.py and the run clears all of it; the only failure is prose-lint (16 findings, 13 of them semicolons), which measures the writing rules rather than rebase judgment. Two assertions are looser than they look: the headline assertion lists three literal phrases but the run wrote "rebased with adjustments" and nothing scripted enforces the vocabulary, and the delta-inventory assertion passes even though the report never presents the four changes as one list. Nothing checks the backup ref or the e2e claim, both of which the report asserts without transcript evidence for the latter.
